Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 8
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an incorrect conclusion by stating that Shane Black was born earlier than Peter Del Monte. In fact, Peter Del Monte was born on July 29, 1943, and Shane Black was born on December 16, 1961. Therefore, Peter Del Monte, the director of Piccoli Fuochi, was born first. The Planner misinterpreted the birth years during the final analysis and incorrectly determined that Shane Black was born earlier.
